_doc: Milling on a 3-axis machine, from a machining service's design guide: the tool comes in along one axis, so a part optimised for it has no undercuts from that side (the problem's mill, '+z' for a tool from above). Read with the problem's filter (about the thinnest wall) and cell. kind community: a service's published guidance, not a standard; your shop's own figures beat it.
name: mill-3axis

wall_metal.rule: Thinnest wall recommended in a metal part (0.5 mm is feasible)
wall_metal.source: Protolabs Network (Hubs), How to design parts for CNC machining, https://www.hubs.com/knowledge-base/how-design-parts-cnc-machining/

wall_metal_feasible.rule: Thinnest wall feasible in a metal part, at a cost
wall_metal_feasible.source: Protolabs Network (Hubs), How to design parts for CNC machining, https://www.hubs.com/knowledge-base/how-design-parts-cnc-machining/

wall_plastic.rule: Thinnest wall recommended in a plastic part (1.0 mm is feasible): plastics warp from residual stress and soften with heat
wall_plastic.source: Protolabs Network (Hubs), How to design parts for CNC machining, https://www.hubs.com/knowledge-base/how-design-parts-cnc-machining/

wall_plastic_feasible.rule: Thinnest wall feasible in a plastic part, at a cost
wall_plastic_feasible.source: Protolabs Network (Hubs), How to design parts for CNC machining, https://www.hubs.com/knowledge-base/how-design-parts-cnc-machining/

corner_per_depth.rule: An inside corner along the tool's axis is round: its radius at least a third of the pocket's depth (a little more lets the tool follow an arc)
corner_per_depth.source: Protolabs Network (Hubs), How to design parts for CNC machining, https://www.hubs.com/knowledge-base/how-design-parts-cnc-machining/

depth_per_width.rule: A pocket at most four times as deep as it is wide, with standard tools
depth_per_width.source: Protolabs Network (Hubs), How to design parts for CNC machining, https://www.hubs.com/knowledge-base/how-design-parts-cnc-machining/

hole_min.rule: Smallest hole feasible; a standard drill size is recommended
hole_min.source: Protolabs Network (Hubs), How to design parts for CNC machining, https://www.hubs.com/knowledge-base/how-design-parts-cnc-machining/
